title: Retain the start and explain the knee-load choice
stage_label: Separate instructional session · Week 2, Day 5 · individually authored; review pending
status_note: Complete written athletic draft for independent source, programming and numeric review. Actual histories, facilities, exact live canonical release and precise separate tumbling remain unverified.
brief: Retain the athlete’s actual short start and recovered route, then teach or retain a transparent knee-resistance decision. The whole known main rehearsal consumes E0 within the existing opportunity ceiling. One directly coached knee set distinguishes bodyweight, first goblet loading, familiar retention, one justified load step and deliberate reintroduction after unloading. Familiar hip, push, pull and brace work preserve full-body exposure without competing new skills.
quality_target: The athlete reproduces the declared start/runoff, accepts the individually chosen knee load or hold, keeps the owned squat range/tempo and communicates when grip, effort or control changes. Record actual observations without calling a first loaded set proof of repeatability.
continuity: Actual OR-01/direct start and knee evidence, OR-06/direct loading/handling context and most recent OR-09/direct reduced support records → retain running while making one justified knee decision → OR-14 changes prompting/group-flow responsibility at retained demand → OR-18 observes the actual comparable entry. Named sessions are evidence opportunities, not compulsory attendance.
audience: Separate on-ramp; 15 athletes, three lanes and two qualified coaches are planning assumptions. Ages 12–14 are the reference, not synonymous with novices. The three age bands have explicit reference doses; actual training history and current response determine the eligible route and smaller caps.
readiness: Running, knee, hip and upper-body permissions are independent. Check actual recent exposure, response, restrictions and outside sport demand before selection. First goblet handling can be learned within the one counted set after actual repeatable bodyweight control; it does not require an earlier completed goblet squat. A newer unload or smaller count is addressed explicitly. Pain, distress, insecure handling, unavailable space or unsafe conduct ends the affected task, without catch-up work.
equipment_space: Three separate straight lanes require the actual selected 10, 15 or 20 m total action path and an outside one-way return of corresponding modeled length with no shared merge. No target-line hard stop. Coach 1 sees starts/queues; coach 2 sees runoff and the separate returns. Personal stationary bays require simultaneous direct view or that mixed delivery is deferred. Knee work needs two stable individually fitting elevated DB parking cradles and suitable preselected fixed DBs; all unused implements stay parked out of paths. No compulsory age load or universal parking height. Familiar hip requires five pre-staged stations and ten simultaneously fitting DBs; push needs five familiar stable supports; rows need five fitting benches/DBs or independently familiar suspension stations. Brace uses individual clear mats and fitting leg supports for the breathing alternative. Actual inventory, fit, layout and sightlines remain unverified.
coaching_flow: Athlete order stays 0–14. Main uses five triads across three lanes, fixed 25 s wave headway and separately protected return paths. Knee uses eight pair turns, one coach per active athlete; the last turn has one athlete. Other strength roles use three waves of five with coaches observing two/three familiar athletes. No cross-station circuit. Next pair waits at an adjacent rear mark outside the active footprint; only after parking/clearance does it enter during its counted 5 s staging allowance. Coach-managed DB selection/change must fit the real setup/reset slack; otherwise delay/omit rather than rush or create an uncounted trial.
clock: Strength / knee, hip, push, pull, brace
time_rules: Every setup, coach demonstration, actual handling, return, rest and transition stays inside the named window. Scheduled times are earliest starts and realistic planning allowances, not speed demands. Extra instruction or a fault delays/omits later work; never shorten minimum recovery, add a makeup set or remove the full preparation base.
preparation_note: Preserve the complete instructional base and its concluding hinge/squat checks. Exactly two targets use 40 s start-position rehearsal plus 140 s declared short walking/standing orientation. This explicit amendment replaces the outline’s proposed purposeful start in preparation with counted E0 inside existing main opportunities; P2 alone does not verify a full running runoff.

exercises.name: Find a quiet ready position
exercises.mapping: ACC-STATIC standing-static setup only; brief teaching use pending delivery mapping
exercises.set_purpose: One quiet start-position hold rehearses the actual familiar bilateral start without a new running effort. The full base already contains the required knee/hip checks; no third target is added.
exercises.execution: Remain in the assigned visible personal bay. Settle for 2 s, then hold the comfortable bilateral ready stance for 3 s with relaxed/ready arms and still feet. Respond to the coach cue without launching. Any subsequent move to walking start marks belongs to the timed P2 gather; a later move to main marks belongs to main opening setup.
exercises.cues: Find your place; stay still; listen before moving.
exercises.errors: Leaving the queue, turning it into a race start, using an unqualified hand-supported stance or ignoring the stop cue.
exercises.rationale: Start-position reminder complements the full base concluding squat check. It precedes one short walking orientation and the counted whole-route main rehearsal.
exercises.metadata: Method: direct demonstration/observation. Tenets: Balance/Coordination. Pattern: standing start/brace. Equipment: marked spaces.

exercises.competency: A first-time athlete needs only a comfortable standing base and basic response to instructions. All ages use the same one3s observation. An experienced newcomer may demonstrate it directly; a failed stop/spacing check keeps travel directly supervised rather than being marked passed.
exercises.progression: Retain a comfortable stance; simplify instructions one at a time. Stop/modify for symptoms, distress or a restriction. This check is participation observation, not clinical clearance.
exercises.continuity: Actual comfortable standing-static start position → one OR-10 3 s hold → known E0 route; OR-14 can reduce prompting while retaining the actual position.

exercises.name: Orient on the known short walking path
exercises.mapping: WALK-ROUTE — existing local OR-WALK-ROUTE walking-orientation context; STAND-READY is the distinct stationary alternative. No running credit or canonical approval is implied.
exercises.set_purpose: One short walk or independently suitable standing action rehearses permission and route conduct without adding a running opportunity. It does not claim to rehearse the complete 20 m technical route.
exercises.execution: Walk on the assigned lane from the start through the 5 m target and selected 5 or 10 m walking exit, then take the marked one-way outside return to the queue. Coach releases each triad only with clearance. Use the declared comfortable ordinary pace, never run to fit time. A stationary alternative uses its visible personal bay and has no return.
exercises.cues: Through the marker; keep going to the exit; return outside.
exercises.errors: Stopping abruptly at the target, cutting across another lane, walking back against traffic or following before clearance.
exercises.rationale: Explicit preparation amendment: retain exactly two targets and the complete base. Put the whole already-qualified start/runoff rehearsal in E0 and count it inside existing main opportunities; do not claim a full progressive start fits this 140 s walk.
exercises.metadata: Method: procedural orientation. Tenets: Coordination/Body Control. Pattern: walking/traffic control. Equipment: cones/clear routes.

exercises.competency: Actual comfortable walking/route conduct and current space must fit the chosen short route; otherwise independently suitable stationary instruction or defer. Neither successful P2 nor attendance creates running or loaded-squat qualification.
exercises.progression: Retain the appropriate actual short walking route or explicitly choose a reduction; no extra running trial. Slower instruction delays/omits, never forces pace.
exercises.continuity: Actual OR-01 short 5+5 walk or OR-08 short 5+10 walk → one declared OR-10 walking orientation → E0 independently retains the actual running route. OR-14 preparation must resolve its own complete clock.

exercises.name: Rehearse the whole retained start within the first opportunity
exercises.mapping: ACC-TEACH or ACC-EASY-TEACH; reviewed local teaching contexts, current canonical release unverified. Independent walking/standing routes are separately mapped.
exercises.set_purpose: First existing main opportunity rehearses the whole known start, target, runoff and return and observes current fit before further work.
exercises.execution: Use the actual standing-static bilateral start. On individual coach permission, move through the 5 m target at the declared retained intent and continue the entire declared runoff; gradually finish under control. Technical route has 15 m runoff; easy route has 10 m. Do not stop hard at the target, cut, race, chase or change stance. Return by the inspected separate one-way walking path after the lane action clears. Walking uses its separate 5+5 m route, not a running substitution claimed equivalent. Stationary action stays in its own visible bay.
exercises.cues: Wait for your own release. Use your known start. Move through the target. Finish gradually in the whole runway. Walk the outside return. Recover before another effort.
exercises.errors: Restoring an older faster/longer route after recent easier running; shortening runoff; uncounted preparation starts; crossing return traffic; treating a fault as an extra practice attempt.
exercises.rationale: Actual OR-01 technical 5+15 and OR-08 easy 5+10 are distinct retained options. The most recent compatible actual route and smaller count govern. No new running-intent progression accompanies new knee load.
exercises.metadata: Method: recovered technical acceleration, not high-intent output certification. Running, ordinary walking and stationary instruction remain distinct. No timed sprint gain or quantified foot-contact result is inferred.

exercises.progression: Retain route, perceived intent and the most recent smaller opportunity ceiling. E0 counts as the first; faults and omissions are never repaid. Easy route stays D-only as its prior contract; L uses qualified technical low-count, walking or standing as actual response permits. No clock or age forces acceleration.

exercises.name: Choose, retain or reduce knee resistance with a stated reason
exercises.mapping: BW-SQUAT-T or GOBLET-OR10. Later exact goblet source: migration447 goblet-squat / dumbbell-goblet / capacity-strength; local review candidate, no live approval claimed.
exercises.set_purpose: The one counted set teaches or retains a justified knee-resistance decision. Grip/pickup/chest support belongs to the set. First loading can be useful instruction without proving repeatability. The athlete explains when to hold, park or stop.
exercises.execution: Bodyweight retains the actual bilateral stance and comfortable 3-1-1 squat, heels level, no box or hand support. Loaded routes use ONE fixed, non-adjustable DB whose head geometry permits comfortable two-hand support: shaft vertical, both palms securely under opposite sides of the upper head, fingers comfortably around its edges, lower head clear of the trunk. The DB stays centered close to the upper chest without forcing wrists, shoulders or a universal finger angle. A stable elevated parking cradle holds the lower head, preventing rolling; set its individually fitting height so pickup does not require an extra deep squat or overhead lift. Coach checks the declared grip/park without an athlete trial. During the counted pickup, confirm actual support before continuing. Retain actual level-heel bilateral stance, range, 3 s descent, 1 s comfortable pause and 1 s ascent, breathing naturally through the effort without prescribed prolonged breath holding. Return the DB to the same stable cradle under control. If this specific DB/grip/park cannot fit, choose eligible bodyweight before the set or defer; do not improvise a kettlebell, rack squat, clean or floor pickup.
exercises.cues: Coach selects the load with you. Support the head securely. Keep the DB close. Use your known range. Breathe and stand. Park before letting go. Say if grip, control or effort changes.
exercises.errors: Calling an older load retention after newer unloading; forcing a grip; adding depth or slower tempo with new load; returning old repetitions after a recent smaller set; treating a failed pickup as an uncounted trial; chasing a heavier DB to satisfy age or the calendar.
exercises.rationale: The dynamic centered one-DB goblet is a direct load option for the owned bilateral squat with one implement and observable handling. Bodyweight is a deliberate instructional/retention option. A box, new stance, independent shoulder rack or kettlebell would change the selected setup/identity and is not needed for the resistance decision. Eight directly observed pair turns provide first-load attention while familiar athletes use their shorter actual handling within the same schedule.
exercises.metadata: Method: one technique-led dynamic set with a declared 3-1-1 tempo. Local capacity-strength source defaults are not copied as first-teaching dosage. Set selection supports Strength and Body Control; confidence is observed, no guaranteed adaptation or sport transfer is claimed.

exercises.name: Retain the familiar hip pattern
exercises.mapping: HINGE-BW; independently familiar TWO-DB RDL alternative retains DB-RDL mechanics
exercises.set_purpose: One hip set preserves actual range, setup and manageable effort while knee-load choice receives the teaching emphasis. Retain recent smaller counts and support; no extra set fills unused time.
exercises.execution: Default: arms crossed at chest, soft knees, hips back3s and stand1s through owned range,5s setup/exit. Familiar DB alternative: actual retained pair at individually fitting elevated parking positions. Hold one DB in each hand with palms inward and arms long; establish a comfortable tall top start with weights near the thighs. Hinge through the owned comfortable hamstring-limited range, with no floor-touch or forced stretch target;4s controlled pickup, three-second lowering/one-second standing repetitions,4s controlled set-down and2s clear. Soft knees, organized trunk, weights remain close; no wall touch, new reach target or grip/handling test. Record kg per DB, total load and actual parking height/range. First-time pickup/top-start/hinge/set-down instruction is not available in this loaded route.
exercises.cues: Keep the owned setup. Hips back. Stand smoothly. Park both weights under control when using them.
exercises.errors: Restoring old DBs after more recent unloading; assuming a firstOR06 teaching set proves familiar handling; one implement substituted for two; a new load or longer set; rushed handling or an extra trial to choose the route.
exercises.rationale: Knee first protects coached load selection; familiar hip, push, pull and brace follow as sequential whole-group roles with explicit recovery. They maintain full-body exposure without another new loaded task or circuit.

exercises.name: Retain the familiar brace pattern
exercises.set_purpose: One brace set preserves actual range, setup and manageable effort while knee-load choice receives the teaching emphasis. Retain recent smaller counts and support; no extra set fills unused time.
exercises.execution: Supine on the mat, arms fixed vertical, hips/knees in comfortable tabletop. Lower one bent leg until a light heel contact at the selected target, return, alternate.2s out/2s back. Tabletop check is setup; first listed contact is the counted moving-limb observation.
exercises.cues: Quiet trunk; light heel; return; keep breathing.
exercises.errors: Heel slide, straight-leg reach, moving the opposite arm, forced floor depth or extra reps to test readiness.
exercises.rationale: Knee first protects coached load selection; familiar hip, push, pull and brace follow as sequential whole-group roles with explicit recovery. They maintain full-body exposure without another new loaded task or circuit.
exercises.metadata: Method: observed low-load control. Tenets: Strength/Body Control. Pattern: supine brace with alternating hip motion.

goblet_first.load_selection_contract: First external knee loading: actual repeatable same-range/stance/3-1-1 bodyweight squat and suitable current response are required. Choose one light individually manageable DB from verified stock before the set; record kg and why its grip/size/load fit. Observe exact grip, pickup and 3 s chest support in counted handling before any loaded rep. No prior whole loaded squat is required. timing_narrative:
**Full preparation plus exactly 180 s targets.** P1 spends 15 s positioning and 10 s reminder, then groups of five start at 25/30/35 s; each has 2 s settle and a 3 s hold, last ends at 40 s. P2 spends 20 s gather/demo including first-triad staging, then triads start at 20/40/60/80/100 s within its 140 s budget. Walk10 takes 15 s action + 20 s outside return; walk15 takes 18 + 20 s. Last long walk returns by 138 s. A mixed short/long sequence may briefly have two returning athletes per outside path; no shared merge/crossing is assumed. Stationary takes 10 s in the visible own bay and has no return. Slower real travel delays/omits; the short walk does not stand in for complete running eligibility.

**Retained start with counted E0.** Main opening setup is 420 s standard or 360 s compressed, including route/response review, coach demonstration, grouping, water and first-triad staging, with no extra athlete run. Standard rounds start main-relative 420/660/900/1140 s (session 22/26/30/34 min); compressed rounds start relative 360/600/840 s (session 16/20/24 min). Each has five triads at offsets 0/25/50/75/100 s, one athlete per lane. Technical action allows 8 s for the 5 m start within 20 s for the whole target/runoff/clearance, followed by 40 s outside walk return. Easy route uses 15 s whole action + 20 s return. Walking uses 15 s whole walk + 40 s return. Stationary uses 10 s and no return. Each route’s exact count and round indices are in its age/mode/cap dose. Technical/walking D has 3 efforts for 9–11, 4 for the other ages standard and 3 for all compressed; L uses only round indices 0 and 2. Easy D has 2 standard / 1 compressed. Standing has 2 standard / 1 compressed. E0 is index 0; E1 never adds it back. Smaller actual caps truncate these scheduled lists. Corresponding D starts are 240 s apart: the maximum 60 s action-plus-return leaves 180 s recovery. L spacing is 480 s. The last maximum-dose standard athlete returns by 36:40, compressed by 26:40; the remaining main time is feedback, water and strength transfer.

**Running and return coexistence.** A 25 s lane headway exceeds the maximum 20 s active-lane envelope. A separate 40 s return can overlap the next return; maximum modeled occupancy is two per dedicated path. Mark actual spacing, start-queue access and no-overtaking/no-crossing conduct; no merge with another lane, active lane or stationary bay. Coach 2 must see both runoff and returns; coach 1 must see starts and waiting triads. Incoming triads stage behind the line during the available headway without crossing returning athletes. If the actual geometry or familiarity cannot support this, delay/omit rather than claim the overlap is automatically safe.

**Knee: one directly observed set for each athlete.** Standard 45–55 min: 120 s setup, eight pair starts at 120/175/230/285/340/395/450/505 s within the 600 s role. Compressed 35–42 min: 60 s setup, starts at 60/105/150/195/240/285/330/375 s within 420 s. One coach watches each active athlete. First/changed load has 6 s grip/pickup/chest setup, 3 s secure chest hold BEFORE loaded reps, at most 4 × 5 s squat reps, then 8 s parking and 3 s clearance: maximum 40 s. Familiar loading uses 4 s pickup, the actual reps, 4 s parking and 2 s clearance: at most 30 s. Bodyweight uses 5 s setup plus actual reps: at most 25 s. After the outgoing pair has cleared, the next pair uses its adjacent rear mark and explicit 5 s stage; first pair stages in setup. Maximum standard final set ends at 545 s, compressed at 415 s. No extra stage follows the last pair. Selected DBs and fitting cradles must be ready; ordinary setup/load changes use actual spare time and cannot overlap an unsafe pickup or be treated as zero-time swaps. When the available slack cannot fit a needed change or instruction, delay/omit later work. Failed grip/pickup ends that counted set and requires coach-managed safe parking, not a replacement BW set.

**Familiar complements, serial whole-group roles.** Standard hip 55–60, push 60–64, pull 64–70, brace 70–75 min. Their setup and wave starts are respectively 75 then 75/150/225 s; 60 then 60/120/180; 90 then 90/165/240; 75 then 75/150/225. Compressed hip 42–45, push 45–47, pull 47–51, brace 51–55: setup/waves are 45 then 45/95/145; 30 then 30/60/90; 60 then 60/120/180; 60 then 60/120/180. Five familiar athletes per wave; coaches observe two/three. Supports and equipment are pre-staged and individually familiar; compressed push does not include first support-height teaching. Maximum bouts: hip DB 26 s (10 handling + 16 reps), BW hip 21 s; push 17 s; row 52 s including both sides/change/handling; heel tap 26 s; supported breathing 40 s plus 15 s quiet recovery. Hip’s 20 s between-wave reset includes incoming staging and ordinary implement management after prior parking/clearance, so 26 + 20 fits the 50 s compressed pitch. Push’s 30 s pitch leaves at least 13 s after its longest familiar bout for clearance/next staging. First groups stage in setup. Most compressed hip finishes are at 171 s or earlier, push 107, pull 232, brace breathing including quiet recovery 235. Actual slower support setup reduces/omits work. Complete per-athlete inter-role recovery must also pass the companion audit; fitting each isolated role alone is insufficient.

**Lower technical-intent carryover.** Technical_20 L retains OR-01's 50–60% perceived intent, not the D range of 60–75%. The separate technical_low_20 packet preserves that actual lower intent even in D, with at most two opportunities on indices 0/2 and the same 20 m action/40 s return contract. An actual one-opportunity history still truncates to E0. This explicitly prevents a booking/mode change from restoring older intensity or volume.

**Fixed knee-station fit in the reference clock.** Each station's selected DB and elevated cradle remain fixed and must fit every assigned user of that station; the last pair uses only one. This is a conditional planning layout, not verified inventory or a demand to use one weight across the group. No mid-turn load swap or cradle-height change is included in the tight compressed 45 s pitch: after a maximum 40 s set its 5 s remainder is entirely incoming staging. If actual individualized selection requires changing a DB or parking height, allocate and observe that real change time before the next pickup, delaying/omitting later work as needed. The reference model does not prove arbitrary mixed loads fit unchanged starts.
alternatives:
**Select from actual history, independently by role.** A most recent lower running demand cannot be replaced with the older technical 20 m route while calling it retention. Use the declared easy 15 m route only under its prior D-mode conditions, or an independently suitable walking/standing choice or defer. Unknown running evidence does not automatically block suitable knee instruction. The total main opportunities include E0, even if E0 is the only opportunity; an unsuitable E0 ends remaining running and never creates a makeup attempt.

**Knee resistance decision.** Bodyweight, first goblet, retained goblet, one small actual increment and reintroduction after newer unloading are separate contexts of the declared dynamic squat. Read each contract and preserve actual smaller 1/2/3 repetition caps. If the recent suitable ceiling is unknown, use the bodyweight at-most-2 observation with its own current suitability gate, not first loading. An actual 1-rep history remains 1. All loaded contexts are D-only. L deliberately unloads to the explicit bodyweight dose; missing actual suitability still means defer. No kg is forced by age. The coach selects a credible fitting DB and parks it before the set, records its actual kg and the current decision, then uses counted first handling to confirm fit before any loaded rep. A weight-search series is not authorized. Reintroduction after an earlier unload must state why current evidence supports a resistance progression and may use an older or lower load; it never automatically restores the older count/load.

**Other roles.** Familiar two-DB hip is D-only and requires the most recent actual compatible loaded record and established 10 s handling; an earlier first-loading set alone is insufficient. Newer unloaded hip work retains BW today. Keep its actual smaller cap. Push and row keep actual familiar height/foot position/bench/grip/load, with a lower-count packet when needed. A familiar suspension row can replace the DB row only under its own verified attachment, angle, grip and control gates. Supported breathing replaces heel taps when its own comfortable supported position is suitable; it does not prove moving-limb control. Retain calf/heel support and bilateral reach, natural 2 s inhale/3 s exhale without a hold, heel pull or hip lift. Do not add a second support task after a fault or use unavailable equipment by implication.

The complete applicable reference and reduced dose packets follow. A listed route is conditional on its explicit gates, not a requirement to deliver every packet. Choose one packet per role and mode; omitted/deferred work is zero, with the reason recorded.

A most recent OR-01 low technical 50–60% record uses technical_low_20 even on a D booking; its ceiling remains two before actual cap1. Default technical_20 L also retains 50–60%, so no L packet silently prescribes the higher D intent. The 15 m easy route is a different target/runoff/intent contract, not a rename of this lower 20 m route.

For each familiar support role, low keeps the prior L counts even in D. The suspension low packet is explicitly 3 bilateral reps in D as well as L; it does not restore the reference D4. If an actual support count is smaller than both supplied packets, preserve that smaller recorded dose only with its complete actual setup/side/recovery record, or defer; the reference ceiling is never a duty to finish. No missing record permits automatic additional work. Unknown longitudinal BW hip count may select cap2 only after actual current familiar pattern/control is independently established; cap1 still governs an actual one-rep history.

Recency is specific to the compatible task. OR-07 supported static knee holds do not overwrite the bilateral squat repetition/load record or create a performed squat-unloading event. Actual OR-07 unloaded hinges can update the compatible hip record. Shared fatigue and response still inform all current decisions, separately from the exact completed exercise history.

workload_narrative:
Keep the complete preparation’s own counts and contact definitions. Targets add one 3 s start hold plus its 2 s setup and one chosen walking/standing action; zero running starts, jumps or throws occur in these two targets. E0 plus E1 equals the selected total main ceiling, with smaller actual caps and cancelled remaining work recorded. Technical running: 5 m target + 15 m runoff per opportunity; easy running: 5 + 10 m. These are separate planned action distances, not measured high-speed metres. Return walking is 20/15 m respectively; walking main route is 10 m action + 10 m return; stationary has zero travel. Natural running/walking foot contacts and actual completed distances remain unknown until observed.

Strength is one selected set each of knee, hip, push, pull and brace; no additional calibration set. Knee reference D is 3/4/4 reps by age, L BW is 2/3/3, before actual smaller caps. New/changed goblet handling adds one pickup, one 3 s pre-rep chest support and one set-down; familiar handling adds one pickup/set-down without a new held assessment. Failed handling can mean zero actual loaded squat reps while still counting handling and consuming the set. Hip, row and brace alternates keep their own handling and per-side units; bilateral suspension repetitions are not one-arm row side counts. Full standard/compact base, main action/runoff/return, strength handling and later tumbling must remain separate workload fields. The final window adds no physical set. The companion audit will resolve all eligible clock cohorts and factored smaller-dose choices, inspect mixed lane traffic and per-athlete recovery, and state its coverage. Actual attendance/results remain null, not zero or a pass.
final_tumbling: Standard 75–90 and compressed 55–60 are recovery, water, brief verbal effort/load/stop-rule teach-back, recording and direct handoff. No race, repeated squat test, extra start or physical finisher is added. The separate 30-minute Body Control / Tumbling segment starts at 90 or 60 minutes and is not included in athletic totals. Its exact approved lesson and actual landing/upper-body demands remain unresolved; do not invent tumbling exercises, contacts or approval. Share the actual route, knee load/hold decision, completed repetitions and handling, hip/upper-body work, symptoms/fatigue and restrictions with that coach. The separate coach selects or defers suitable content under its own current authority. A missing precise tumbling link is an explicit incomplete product element, not a fabricated zero-load session.

For knee record bodyweight/first/retained/load-step/reintroduced decision, current reason, actual DB identity/kg/grip/parking height and any earlier unloading; for a step record both kg values and actual increment. During delivery record assigned versus completed opportunities, E0 response, faults/omissions, actual handling and loaded reps separately, individual rest and assistance/attention needed. Keep actual hip/support variants, kg/height/angle/range, caps and response. Afterward record the athlete’s explanation and the next conditional OR-14 retained flow task; OR-18 compares actual conditions without a harder graduation test. Do not infer attendance, skill passes or main-entry permission from the lesson number. Full Week 2 review must reconcile OR-06–10 and Week 3 carryover before proceeding into Week 3 detail.

age_scaling_policy.equal_dose_reason: Short low-effort preparation is not age-based overload. Explicit equal doses across ages are deliberate; task skill, body size, comfortable range and current readiness decide the variant.
age_scaling_policy.readiness_independent_of_age: Experienced younger athletes may use qualified familiar actions; unfamiliar older athletes use instruction. Age never grants flight, rapid descent, floor support, loaded patterns or cue response.

layout_and_timing_assumptions.layout: Three columns of five distinct 3 m × 3 m personal bays: 15 independent working spaces. Five athletes share a lane assignment, never an overlapping crawl corridor.
layout_and_timing_assumptions.additional_space: Unobstructed peripheral coach circulation/access/egress and separately verified start, runoff and return corridors are additional to the 9 m × 15 m bay rectangle. The marked rectangle is not the total facility footprint.
layout_and_timing_assumptions.travel: Standing paths remain in personal bays. Short forward passes are at most 1.6 m; backward/lateral spans 1 m or less except 1.5 m carioca. Individually check full hand-walk/plank footprint before use.
layout_and_timing_assumptions.orientation: All bays face one end. Complete a pass and stop before ordinary walking return within that same bay. No crossing between athletes or concurrent opposite-direction traffic inside a bay.
layout_and_timing_assumptions.coaches: Familiar shared practice: one coach scans A/B and one scans B/C with clear oblique views. Three-wave teaching/checks: both coaches watch one active lane and split five athletes 2/3; other lanes stand. Clear views of all active feet/trunks are required.
layout_and_timing_assumptions.wave_handover: The active lane finishes standing, then the next lane starts on cue. The 2-second change (3 seconds for floor teaching) is a cue change, not relocation. Athletes stay in their own bays.
layout_and_timing_assumptions.equipment: Flat markers, bottles outside active rectangles, clean dry nonslip surface. No partner support, unstable props or unverified anchor is assumed.
layout_and_timing_assumptions.setup_before_clock: Mark/inspect space before class. Readiness/restriction information must be available. First demonstration includes stop cue and immediate comfort check. Unknown restrictions or inability to follow safe directions require individual resolution, never assumed clearance.
layout_and_timing_assumptions.clock_definition: Row time = demonstration + waves × individual execution envelope + explicit wave handovers + reset/transition. The individual envelope includes stated steps, pauses and returns. Shared practice means separate bays, not 15 times one athlete dose.
layout_and_timing_assumptions.tempo_rule: Execution envelopes are estimates for the stated variant, not speed commands. If safe learning/movement needs longer, use contingency, remove optional work or revise the booking. Never rush to validate arithmetic.
layout_and_timing_assumptions.bay_to_target_transition: Base ends at 12:00 full or 7:00 compact with athletes standing in bays. Reserve exactly 180 seconds for exactly two parent-owned target tasks. The parent exemplar defines the split and charges bay-to-start gathering, demonstrations, observed holds, rehearsal, exit and return within those 180 seconds. Use the parent-defined allocation; do not double-charge gathering or hide it before the base ends.
layout_and_timing_assumptions.physical_validation_status: UNVERIFIED: measured space, body fit, sightlines, surface, shared-floor schedule and target corridors have not been observed. Arithmetic does not certify physical feasibility.

teaching_and_competency_policy.full_familiar: Sixteen ordered slots with reminder demonstrations only. SP-11/SP-12 explicitly repeat mastered A-March because exact B/C identities are unverified.
teaching_and_competency_policy.compact_familiar: Eleven slots in original relative order. Omit SP-04, SP-10, SP-11, SP-12, SP-14. Retain floor purpose through the declared stationary-bear modification; hinge and squat remain last.
teaching_and_competency_policy.or01_full: Eleven recognizable slots in 12 minutes. Easy march replaces jog; optional crossing/flight/B/C complexity is omitted; lunges lose rotation/depth; floor flow becomes knees-down rock-backs; descent is slow; basic march/foot-roll precede observed hinge and partial squat-to-stand. After the easy raise, all actions are demonstrated and observed in three five-athlete waves.
teaching_and_competency_policy.or01_compact: Same eleven recognizable slots in 7 minutes. Basic walking/stepping/foot-roll can follow the coach in separate bays. Lunge, floor, slow drop, hinge and partial squat remain serialized in three observed five-athlete waves. One hinge and one squat cycle are readiness observations; qualification belongs to subsequent instructional work.
deferred_complexity: Traveling bear crawl and new complete plank/downward-dog flow
Full toe/ankle contact and overhead squat-to-stand range when unavailable
teaching_and_competency_policy.what_deferred_means: Practice the simpler named component in its original place; log performed variant and unfilled demand. Teach additional complexity in a relevant later instructional module. Do not silently pass it, substitute a generic unrelated warm-up or add teaching outside the clock.
teaching_and_competency_policy.partial_competency: Existing evidence can support a familiar variation, independently of age. Preparation completion does not unlock a main family: no-flight lowering is not landing, marching is not running, rock-back is not tumbling, and no throw/cue gate is tested here.
teaching_and_competency_policy.correction_limit: Use visible contingency for actual slower movement or brief corrective repeat and record time/dose/contacts. If essential teaching remains incomplete, mark profile/session REVISE and use the 12-minute instructional base or a justified booking adjustment. Never consume the reserved target time or speed up movement.
teaching_and_competency_policy.optional_reduction_order: For familiar full, remove SP-12 then SP-11, then SP-04/SP-10/SP-14 as readiness/purpose permits. Record omissions and revised clock. Compact/OR already omit these; beyond contingency, further necessary omissions require explicit review rather than an unqualified complete-base claim.

flight_not_qualified_overlay.application: For otherwise familiar athletes whose flight is unqualified, independent of age. This can accompany an independently qualified throw-only main branch, but does not itself authorize throwing or a cue.
flight_not_qualified_overlay.SP-01: Easy march in place for the same 60 seconds full or 50 seconds compact; no flight.
flight_not_qualified_overlay.SP-08: Retain a separately qualified no-flight rapid descent. If unlearned, slow drop squat to stick: 3 × 8-second envelopes, each 2 s lower + 2 s hold + 1 s stand + 3 s reset; no travel. Record changed variant.
flight_not_qualified_overlay.SP-10: Omit four A-Skip hop landings; freed time is recovery, not another drill.
flight_not_qualified_overlay.SP-13: Eight alternating no-flight foot-roll actions, four each side: 8 × 2 s + 4 s standing reset = 20 seconds; no travel. Log changed variant.
flight_not_qualified_overlay.SP-14: Omit six bilateral pogo landing events; no substitute jump.
flight_not_qualified_overlay.accounting: Subtract omitted flight events and record actual time/contacts. Reduced-impact preparation grants no JUMP-T, REACT-T, throwing, early-release or go/no-go qualification.

records.name: Backpedal
records.purpose: Rehearse controlled backward travel and orientation.

card_mapping_status.limit: A related backpedal-to-sprint identity is not this slow preparation task.

records.setup: Face the same end of the room. Mark 1 m behind the start; two short backward steps reach it, then two forward walking steps return. No turn or crossing.
cues: Short steps under you; look forward.
Check the clear space behind you before moving.
common_errors: Long reaching steps and backward lean.
stop_rules: Stop for obstacle, balance loss or pain; use ordinary walking return only when clear.

competency_rule.observe: Controls both backward steps and forward return with balance and stop-cue response.
competency_rule.pass_scope: Preparation observation only. A completed repetition does not grant a main-family, loaded-strength, flight, throwing, cue-response or tumbling qualification.
competency_rule.record: Log selected profile, actual variant/dose, comfort, response to cue, omissions and not-observed actions. No actual results are invented.

records.name: Lateral shuffle

card_mapping_status.limit: This low-intent short shuffle is not reactive cutting.

records.setup: Start centered. Step-close without crossing for 1 m right and 1 m left back to start. Repeat only for the familiar dose.
cues: Stay facing forward; step then close.
Own the stop.
common_errors: Reaching past the bay or racing the return.
stop_rules: Stop if feet collide, boundary control fails or discomfort appears.

records.name: Walking lunge with rotation/reach
records.purpose: Access comfortable split position, front-leg control and coordinated reach.

card_mapping_status.limit: A lunge matrix is related content, not approval for this precise forward-step/reach/return task.

records.setup: Forward step within a 1 m span, then return after each rep. Reach toward the front knee with a small comfortable trunk turn. First visit uses thigh contact and no rotation.
cues: Use a stable split base; lower only as far as controlled.
Turn gently toward the front leg and return tall.
common_errors: Forced depth or twisting over a painful knee.
stop_rules: Stop for pain or instability; use smaller split-stance bend if comfortable, otherwise omit and record.

competency_rule.observe: Comfortable split position on both sides with stable foot pressure and smooth return.
competency_rule.pass_scope: Preparation observation only. A completed repetition does not grant a main-family, loaded-strength, flight, throwing, cue-response or tumbling qualification.
competency_rule.record: Log selected profile, actual variant/dose, comfort, response to cue, omissions and not-observed actions. No actual results are invented.

records.name: Lateral lunge with reach
records.purpose: Access comfortable lateral hip shift and stable foot pressure.

verified_local_names: Lateral Lunge to Rotational Reach Flow
card_mapping_status.limit: The related flow includes rotation; this plain reach requires exact variant review.

records.setup: Step sideways within a 0.75 m span; shift into that hip, reach toward the thigh and return. First visit keeps hands on thigh and a shallow shift.
cues: Sit gently into the stepping hip.
Reach only with controlled trunk position.
common_errors: Chasing depth or lifting support foot unexpectedly.
stop_rules: Stop for unstable foot, discomfort or uncontrolled return.

competency_rule.observe: Comfortable lateral shift and return both sides without forced depth.
competency_rule.pass_scope: Preparation observation only. A completed repetition does not grant a main-family, loaded-strength, flight, throwing, cue-response or tumbling qualification.
competency_rule.record: Log selected profile, actual variant/dose, comfort, response to cue, omissions and not-observed actions. No actual results are invented.

records.name: Inchworm → plank → bear crawl → downward dog (ordered slot)
records.purpose: Prepare shoulder/wrist support, trunk control, hip movement and floor transitions with low fatigue.

verified_local_names: Inchworm → plank → bear crawl → downward dog
Inchworm to World’s Greatest Stretch (related legacy flow)
card_mapping_status.limit: Exact composite not established. Stationary limb unloads explicitly replace traveling bear crawl for 15-bay delivery. Knees-down rock-backs are a declared partial-purpose regression, not an exact approved composite. The proposed stationary substitution is specifically four separately mastered single-limb lifts with full replants, not an unspecified weight shift or contralateral crawl.

records.setup: One athlete per dry nonslip 3 m × 3 m bay. Entire floor footprint fits before use. No shared slow-crawl lane or following crawler. Coach checks hand/knee comfort before support. Familiar bear support uses one limb at a time: left hand, right hand, left foot, right foot. A lift means the whole selected hand or foot briefly clears the floor by about 1–2 cm; it is not merely a weight shift. Fully replant and settle before the next limb.
cues: Hands comfortable; breathe with controlled trunk.
Quiet unhurried transitions; soft knees in downward dog.
Keep the trunk quiet; lift one contact only, then fully replant before the next.
Do not lift opposite hand and foot together.
common_errors: Forced straight knees or shoulder range.
Starting the next lift before the previous contact is fully replanted.
Rotating or sagging the trunk to clear the limb.
stop_rules: Stop for wrist/shoulder pain, slipping, trunk-control loss or inadequate footprint.
Use contingency or record incomplete rather than rushing floor entry.

Omit the familiar bear-lift component if any single-limb lift/replant has not already been mastered; use the entire named instructional floor profile and its coaching clock, or record incomplete purpose. No new bear-lift teaching is assumed inside the familiar reminder.

competency_rule.observe: Comfortable actual support and floor entry/exit. Rock-back does not pass plank/bear or tumbling support. For familiar bear lifts, each selected contact clears briefly, fully replants, and the trunk remains quiet before the next lift.
competency_rule.pass_scope: Preparation observation only. A completed repetition does not grant a main-family, loaded-strength, flight, throwing, cue-response or tumbling qualification.
competency_rule.record: Log selected profile, actual variant/dose, comfort, response to cue, omissions and not-observed actions. No actual results are invented.

full.variant: Inchworm → high plank → stationary bear-position single-limb lifts/full replants → downward dog → standing

execution_segments.name: Move to hands-and-knees then low bear position
Left hand, right hand, left foot, right foot: one contact clears 1–2 cm then fully replants before the next
execution_segments.execution_detail: Per 2-second lift/replant: about 0.5 s clear the selected contact, 0.5 s fully replant, 1 s settle with all four contacts before the next lift; quiet trunk throughout.

full.tempo: Known controlled flow. Four single-limb lift/replant cycles at 2 s each: brief 0.5 s lift, 0.5 s full replant, 1 s stable reset. Do not start the next lift before stable full contact.
full.effort: Easy and conversational; no maximal speed, height, stretch or fatigue target.

execution_segments.name: Move to hands-and-knees then low bear position
Left hand, right hand, left foot, right foot: one contact clears 1–2 cm then fully replants before the next
execution_segments.execution_detail: Per 2-second lift/replant: about 0.5 s clear the selected contact, 0.5 s fully replant, 1 s settle with all four contacts before the next lift; quiet trunk throughout.

compact.tempo: Known controlled flow. Four single-limb lift/replant cycles at 2 s each: brief 0.5 s lift, 0.5 s full replant, 1 s stable reset. Do not start the next lift before stable full contact.
compact.effort: Easy and conversational; no maximal speed, height, stretch or fatigue target.

rest.within_set: Only the pauses, resets and walking returns explicitly included in execution_segments.
rest.after_set: Use the row transition and next demonstration. Waiting waves add no repetitions. Extra required rest uses visible contingency, then an explicit reduction/revision.

compact.other_contact_accounting: No intentional flight; ordinary support/steps are not scored plyometric landings.
compact.prerequisite: Previously demonstrated comfortable floor access, wrist/shoulder support, brief plank, low bear position, EACH prescribed single-limb lift and full replant in left-hand/right-hand/left-foot/right-foot order with quiet trunk, downward-dog access and standing return. Plank/bear hold or weight-shift competence alone does not qualify the lifts. Verify body footprint fits.
compact.contact_rule: One selected contact briefly off floor; other three remain planted. Full four-contact replant/reset before the next lift. No paired contralateral lift.
compact.count_definition: One repetition requires completion of the entire ordered flow. Segment holds, transitions and four limb lift/full-replant actions are constituents, not additional flow repetitions.

count_reconciliation.calculation: One completed flow containing 4 individual lift/full-replant actions (left hand, right hand, left foot, right foot); do not sum heterogeneous segment counts into flow reps.
count_reconciliation.partial_cycle_rule: A fraction in conversion arithmetic is not an accepted partial repetition. Record completed whole cycles/actions/sequences actually performed.

records.name: Squat-to-stand with overhead reach — concluding check
records.purpose: Observe knee/hip/trunk organization through a comfortable sequence.

card_mapping_status.limit: Source 62 is review state. Familiar prescription follows candidate variant sequential-bilateral-reach-squat-to-stand: standing hinge/contact, comfortable squat, one controlled overhead reach per assigned side, stand/reset. Assigned order is left then right. Current exact dose/profile eligibility remains unverified. The OR thigh-supported partial version remains an explicitly different modification pending variant review.

records.setup: Same three five-athlete observation waves. Comfortable stance/reachable contact points; no forced toe touch or depth. Coaches see feet and trunk. Familiar source-linked sequence assigns LEFT reach and return, then RIGHT reach and return while the opposite hand maintains its comfortable toe/ankle contact; stand only after both reaches. Each reach stays in controlled comfortable range.
cues: Use comfortable range and a stable foot.
Reach without forced rib flare; stand smoothly.
Left reach and return, right reach and return, then stand; do not skip a side.
common_errors: Counting one reach as completion of the familiar sequential-bilateral cycle.
stop_rules: Stop for pain or uncontrolled balance/trunk; use declared partial sequence if comfortable. Longer teaching uses contingency or records incomplete.

competency_rule.observe: Observe actual sequence, foot pressure and control; not a loaded squat or tumbling qualification.
competency_rule.pass_scope: Preparation observation only. A completed repetition does not grant a main-family, loaded-strength, flight, throwing, cue-response or tumbling qualification.
competency_rule.record: Log selected profile, actual variant/dose, comfort, response to cue, omissions and not-observed actions. No actual results are invented.

full.variant: Sequential bilateral-reach squat-to-stand: comfortable contact → squat → left reach/return → right reach/return → stand/reset

execution_segments.name: Complete hinge/contact, squat, left reach/return, right reach/return, stand/reset cycle

within_repetition_timing.action: left overhead reach within comfortable range and return to contact
right overhead reach within comfortable range and return to contact

full.tempo: Per complete 8 s cycle: hinge/contact 1; comfortable squat 1; left reach 1 and return 1; right reach 1 and return 1; stand 1; reset 1. Keep the opposite hand at its comfortable contact during each reach. No forced range or rushing.
full.effort: Easy and conversational; no maximal speed, height, stretch or fatigue target.

rest.within_set: Only the pauses, resets and walking returns explicitly included in execution_segments.
rest.after_set: Use the row transition and next demonstration. Waiting waves add no repetitions. Extra required rest uses visible contingency, then an explicit reduction/revision.

full.other_contact_accounting: No intentional flight; ordinary support/steps are not scored plyometric landings.
full.prerequisite: Known comfortable contact/hinge/squat sequence, separately controlled LEFT then RIGHT overhead reach-and-return while maintaining balance, and stand/reset. Complete both sides within comfortable range. If unavailable, use the explicitly different partial OR profile and its complete coaching clock; no source-exact claim for a partial reach.
full.dose_adaptation_status: Explicit coach-review proposal: full 4 cycles or compact 2 cycles preserve both source-assigned reaches and observed three-wave checks within 720/420 s. Full philosophy starting dose 5 is reduced rather than omitting one side or forcing speed; not an operational approval.
full.count_definition: One complete familiar contact/hinge, squat, LEFT reach-and-return, RIGHT reach-and-return, stand/reset is one bilateral repetition. The declared OR partial sequence is a different action with one simultaneous comfortable partial two-arm reach.

count_reconciliation.calculation: 4 familiar complete cycles contain 4 left overhead reaches and 4 right overhead reaches = 8 total reach actions; count 4 whole cycles, not 8 squat repetitions.
count_reconciliation.partial_cycle_rule: A fraction in conversion arithmetic is not an accepted partial repetition. Record completed whole cycles/actions/sequences actually performed.

contact_accounting.landing_event_unit: One landing event after flight; bilateral landing is one event involving two feet.
contact_accounting.foot_contact_unit: One foot contacting the surface; bilateral landing contributes two foot contacts.
contact_accounting.task_contact_scope: Where numeric, excludes ordinary walking returns; it does not mean all task contacts follow flight. Other ordinary step/support counts remain in the per-side/segment detail or actual log.
contact_accounting.unknown_count_rule: Null means not predetermined or not a total-contact prescription; never coerce it to zero. A zero flight count does not mean zero standing/support/step contacts.

rest.within_set: Only the pauses, resets and walking returns explicitly included in execution_segments.
rest.after_set: Use the row transition and next demonstration. Waiting waves add no repetitions. Extra required rest uses visible contingency, then an explicit reduction/revision.

or01_compact.other_contact_accounting: No intentional flight; ordinary support/steps are not scored plyometric landings.
or01_compact.prerequisite: Comfortable action, clear personal bay and ability to stop on cue.
or01_compact.count_definition: One complete familiar contact/hinge, squat, LEFT reach-and-return, RIGHT reach-and-return, stand/reset is one bilateral repetition. The declared OR partial sequence is a different action with one simultaneous comfortable partial two-arm reach.

count_reconciliation.calculation: 1 explicitly partial bilateral sequences; internal positions and shared left/right participation do not add repetitions.
count_reconciliation.partial_cycle_rule: A fraction in conversion arithmetic is not an accepted partial repetition. Record completed whole cycles/actions/sequences actually performed.

contact_accounting.landing_event_unit: One landing event after flight; bilateral landing is one event involving two feet.
contact_accounting.foot_contact_unit: One foot contacting the surface; bilateral landing contributes two foot contacts.
contact_accounting.task_contact_scope: Where numeric, excludes ordinary walking returns; it does not mean all task contacts follow flight. Other ordinary step/support counts remain in the per-side/segment detail or actual log.
contact_accounting.unknown_count_rule: Null means not predetermined or not a total-contact prescription; never coerce it to zero. A zero flight count does not mean zero standing/support/step contacts.

15-18.age_specific_delivery: Measure body-length/arm-span fit inside the bay; older age does not increase speed, travel, contacts or repetitions.

workload_and_tumbling_interface.purpose: Finish warm and organized, not tired. Effort about 2/10 and conversational; this is not overload or conditioning.
workload_and_tumbling_interface.full_flight: Four unilateral A-Skip hop landings and six bilateral pogo landing events are explicitly prescribed in the familiar full profile. Timed easy jog and ankling also carry impact; their actual flight/contact detail is recorded instead of fabricated.
workload_and_tumbling_interface.compact_flight: A-Skip/pogo are omitted, but easy jog still has impact and ankling actual contacts remain in the record. Compressed is not automatically impact-free.
workload_and_tumbling_interface.or01_flight: No intentional flight in the first-visit profiles; no landing gate is thereby passed.
workload_and_tumbling_interface.upper_body: Familiar floor work includes a 4-second high plank, brief bear-position support/unloads and downward-dog access. Count wrist/shoulder/trunk demand alongside throwing, pressing, bracing and separate tumbling. Rock-back support is still support.
workload_and_tumbling_interface.tumbling: The separate 30-minute tumbling/Body Control allocation remains unprescribed here. Share actual comfort, support/impact exposure and observations with its coach. Its later load and staffing remain unverified.

reviewable_modifications.change: Easy jog in place and shortened bay-contained travel replace starting-distance layout.
reviewable_modifications.reason: Keep purpose with no crossing or long queue travel.
reviewable_modifications.review_status: Exact delivery mapping and measured footprint require review.

reviewable_modifications.change: Stationary bear-position limb unloads replace traveling bear crawl in the familiar composite.
reviewable_modifications.reason: Five sequential slow crawlers per lane cannot be treated as simultaneous overlapping athletes.
reviewable_modifications.alternative_arithmetic: At 32 seconds per athlete, five serial waves in three parallel lanes require at least 160 seconds of work before demo/clearance, versus 32 seconds with separate bays: 128 seconds extra. Adding that to the complete full clock exceeds 720 seconds without another explicit change.
reviewable_modifications.review_status: Purpose-preserving proposal; exact composite and facility delivery remain unapproved.

reviewable_modifications.change: B/C ordered slots perform and record only mastered A-March; compact/OR omit them.
reviewable_modifications.reason: Do not invent an unverified B-march, hip-opening march or C-skip.
reviewable_modifications.review_status: B/C identity/delivery remains unresolved; short A-March profile also needs review.

reviewable_modifications.change: Familiar concluding squat-to-stand now uses four full or two compact complete 8-second LEFT-then-RIGHT reach cycles. Compact hinge remains two reps; OR01 compact remains one observed hinge and one partial squat cycle.
reviewable_modifications.reason: Preserve both source-assigned reaches, safe control and ordered three-wave observation within 720/420 seconds. This explicitly reduces the philosophy full starting dose of five to four; compact squat count changes from three ambiguous cycles to two complete cycles. The philosophy permits scaled repetitions.
reviewable_modifications.review_status: Coach-review adaptation of repetition count and delivery, not publication or operational approval. Brief readiness observations do not pass competence; finish required evidence in instructional work.

reviewable_modifications.change: First-visit flow, reach, descent and rhythm use explicitly simpler/no-flight components.
reviewable_modifications.reason: Teach recognizable components honestly instead of pretending reminder demos teach every complex action.
reviewable_modifications.review_status: If actual essential instruction exceeds contingency, mark REVISE and use longer instructional base or another justified booking change.

validation.count_accounting_status: PASS: all 192 age/profile dose objects have explicit primary count units; included numeric doses reconcile through segment primary-unit contributions; bilateral landings retain event/foot distinction; null unknown contact counts remain null; override routes resolve explicit dose/rest/profile references or explicit zero-dose omission.

counting_conventions.primary_repetitions: Always interpret reps_total with count_unit and count_definition. Mixed flow constituents, side counts, foot contacts and timed segments are not interchangeable.
counting_conventions.segment_repetitions: Each execution segment has its own count_unit. Its duration remains repetitions × seconds_each. Primary count contributions convert the segment counts to the record primary unit; complete cycles remain the accepted unit.
counting_conventions.SP-09_and_fallback_normalization: A-March primary counts are now individual steps: 8 familiar (4 each side) or 4 OR (2 each side). Bilateral cycle counts are explicit secondary metadata; actual movement/time unchanged.
counting_conventions.SP-13_correction: Familiar full/compact is 16 individual ankling task contacts, eight each foot; OR01 full/compact is four individual foot-roll/replace actions, two each foot. No execution duration or physical dose changed.
counting_conventions.contact_rule: Landing events and per-foot landing contacts are separate. Timed jogging/actual ankling flight count stays null when not predetermined, never zero by default.
